title: Admissible Portfolio Optimization: Information Constraints, Conditional Efficient Frontiers, and the Price of Causal Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.00147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mean--variance portfolio choice takes the conditioning information as given and optimizes over weights, so two errors about that information pass into the portfolio unseen: using variables unavailable at the decision time and treating common variation as idiosyncratic. We make the conditioning information a decision variable subject to hard admissibility constraints declared in advance: availability, a no-arbitrage-preserving enlargement of the decision filtration, statistical separation and, for interventional claims, invariance across declared regimes. A lexicographic admissibility order in which no risk--return quantity enters selects an optimal information class, and the classical problem is solved inside it. translated_title: 可容许投资组合优化：信息约束、条件有效前沿与因果识别的代价
translated_abstract: 均值-方差投资组合选择将条件信息视为给定，仅对权重进行优化，因此关于该信息的两类错误会在不被察觉的情况下传入组合：使用决策时点尚不可获得的变量，以及将共同变动误当作特质变动。我们将条件信息本身变为一个决策变量，使其服从事先声明的硬性可容许性约束：可获得性、保持无套利的决策信息流扩张、统计可分性，以及（对于干预性论断而言）跨所声明状态（regime）的不变性。通过一个不含任何风险-收益数量的字典序可容许性排序来选出最优信息类，并在该信息类内部求解经典问题。我们证明了存在性、在重编码下的不变性，以及一个可容许信息价值定理，该定理的失效条件表明：基于决策损失的选择只要遇到前瞻信息就会将其纳入；两阶段解……
tldr: 该论文将均值-方差组合优化的条件信息本身作为决策变量，施加事先声明的可容许性约束（可获得性、保持无套利的信息流扩张、统计可分性与跨状态不变性），从而在源头排除前瞻偏差与共同因子误判，并证明可容许信息价值定理及“按决策损失选择信息会引入前瞻信息”的失效条件。
en_tdlr: This paper makes the conditioning information itself a decision variable in mean-variance portfolio optimization, subject to pre-declared admissibility constraints (availability, no-arbitrage-preserving filtration enlargement, statistical separation, and regime invariance) to eliminate look-ahead bias and the misclassification of common variation, and proves a value-of-admissible-information theorem showing that selection by decision loss admits look-ahead information whenever present.
